reason: I'd maybe poke at the free plan, but I'm not paying 59-99 € a month for 'AI co-workers' when I can't see which integrations actually exist or what a credit buys. I already have Zapier and HubSpot doing half of this, and I don't have the hours to set up and babysit another layer on top.
objection: 'Connects to the tools you already use' with a '...' isn't an integration list, and 100 credits a month means nothing to me until I know how many automations that actually runs. I'd be paying for a vague promise and then spending my evenings fixing it.
would_change_my_mind: A public integration list showing native HubSpot and Zapier/Make connections, plus a clear credits-to-tasks breakdown, and the onboarding team setting up one real workflow, like lead follow-up from my CRM, in under an hour during the free trial.
